sources.README.md:
# Workspace drafts with asynchronous acknowledgements

open/edit/close are synchronous. The editor currently submits every edit.
A visit's latest pending text must be submitted exactly once before close or
navigation returns; submission must not wait for network acknowledgement.
Accepted writes belong to the document, survive navigation, and all settle.
Store read exposes the latest accepted draft for immediate reopen; readPersisted
exposes acknowledged data, protected by write revision against late old writes.
The provided transport accepts a write synchronously and returns a Promise.
Its start callback may synchronously open another document, reopen the same
one, hide the editor, or edit that new visit. Acceptance occurs before that hook.
Navigation priority follows call start order: a newer open/close supersedes an
outer navigation that resumes after a save-start callback. Obsolete destinations
must not render. A newly accepted edit must not be erased by old flush cleanup.

A save-status notification may appear only for the current visit's latest edit.
A pending newer edit invalidates an older acknowledgement even before its own
write is submitted. store.write(id,text,owner) round-trips an opaque owner token;
attachSaveStatus supports an owner predicate. Reopening the same document does
not give its new visit ownership of the old visit's acknowledgement.
Do not cancel accepted saves to suppress UI messages. No network failures or
retry policy are included in this fixture; each transport Promise settles once.

The search preview is transient: 40 ms quiet interval, discard pending query
on hide, reusable afterward. It is outside the editor maintenance request.

rules.body: Apply when introducing trailing editor persistence while preserving synchronous navigation, callback-capable write acceptance, and asynchronous acknowledgements whose UI authority is narrower than their persistence lifetime. TASK states: "Coalesce edits using the existing trailing-task utility: after a 120 ms quiet\ninterval, write only the latest text in that editing burst. Subsequent bursts\nmust continue to save. Preserve the editor's other behavior and public interfaces." README.md states: "Accepted writes belong to the document, survive navigation, and all settle."

Use the existing trailing-task utility with a 120 ms quiet interval. Each edit replaces the pending arguments and restarts the deadline; bind those arguments to the accepting document and edit rather than consulting current selection at execution time. Preserve empty text, subsequent bursts, and no-selection editing. src/trailing-task.js contains "pending = args;" and "handle = timers.schedule(flush, delay);". Original src/editor.js contains "if (!current) return;". No additional persistent buffer bank or editor text model is required by these sources.

Establish the newest edit's opaque owner token immediately when accepting the edit, before delayed submission. Preserve exact visit identity as well as latest-edit identity when authorizing status. Original src/editor.js contains "const visit = current, owner = {};" and "visit.latest = owner;". README.md states: "A save-status notification may appear only for the current visit's latest edit.\nA pending newer edit invalidates an older acknowledgement even before its own\nwrite is submitted." src/save-status.js contains "if (event.id === id && accepts(event.owner)) renderStatus(event);". Reopening the same document must not authorize an old visit's acknowledgement.

On departure, capture the departing visit, revoke its current ownership, detach its captured status subscription, and flush its pending text exactly once before returning. Flush before reading a replacement document, but do not await acknowledgement. Original src/editor.js contains "const old = current; current = null;" and "if (old) old.stop();". README.md states: "A visit's latest pending text must be submitted exactly once before close or\nnavigation returns; submission must not wait for network acknowledgement." It also states: "Store read exposes the latest accepted draft for immediate reopen; readPersisted\nexposes acknowledged data, protected by write revision against late old writes." Include disposal through src/workspace.js: "dispose() { editor.close(); },".

After departure flushing can invoke a transport start callback, revalidate navigation authority before installing or rendering an open destination or clearing document output for close. Protect clearing effects as well as installation; complete them before callback-capable work or guard them afterward. README.md states: "Navigation priority follows call start order: a newer open/close supersedes an\nouter navigation that resumes after a save-start callback. Obsolete destinations\nmust not render." Cleanup must use captured departing resources so a resumed outer request cannot detach a successor or discard its pending edits.

Preserve independent accepted writes and restrict stale effects at publication rather than cancelling persistence. src/draft-store.js accepts text before transport with "revisions.set(id, revision); accepted.set(id, text);", creates "const event = Object.freeze({ id, text, revision, owner });", and invokes "const pending = transport(event);". Its acknowledgement path uses "if (revision > (committed.get(id) || 0))" before updating persisted data and returns the event. Preserve these revision, Promise, event, and subscription semantics. README.md states: "Do not cancel accepted saves to suppress UI messages." Preserve synchronous editor/workspace interfaces and original document rendering "renderDocument({id, text:store.read(id)});" and close rendering "renderDocument(null);".

Keep durable editor departure flushing separate from transient preview cancellation. TASK states: "The adjacent search preview is outside this maintenance change." src/search-preview.js contains "const task = createTrailingTask(query => publish({ query }), 40, timers);" and "hide() { task.cancel(); },". Preserve its 40 ms delay, discard-on-hide policy, and later reuse. Do not import submission receipts, projection archives, confirmation outlets, persistent buffer banks, or integration-detachment APIs from related experiences when absent from the current public API.

Use controlled timers and independently resolvable transport Promises to check deadline resetting, no active-burst write before 120 ms of quiet, one latest-text write per burst, subsequent bursts, empty text, and no-selection edits. Exercise switch, close, same-document reopening, and dispose with pending edits; verify exactly-once submission before return and immediate accepted-text restoration without acknowledgement. From both timer-driven and departure-driven transport starts, request nested open, same-document reopen, or close and edit the successor; verify the newest navigation's output survives and successor edits save independently without duplicate consumption. Resolve acknowledgements out of order; verify all settle, persisted data does not roll back, retired visits produce no status, and a pending newer edit suppresses an older acknowledgement before its own submission. Also verify current latest-edit status and unchanged preview timing, hide cancellation, and reuse. These checks derive from TASK and the cited public behavior, not the acceptance verdict.

rules.body:
Apply when deferred editor persistence must preserve synchronous departure persistence, inline save-listener navigation, and entry-bound submissions with visit-bound notices. TASK states: "Coalesce edits using the existing trailing-task utility: after a 120 ms quiet
interval, write only the latest text in that editing burst. Subsequent bursts
must continue to save. Preserve the editor's other behavior and public interfaces." README.md states: "When close/open returns, the departed document's last accepted edit is readable
from the store. A close/open request retires its previous save badge immediately."

Update the accepting editor's in-memory text synchronously, then enqueue persistence using the existing trailing-task utility with a 120 ms quiet interval. Bind delayed work to the accepting document rather than consulting the later selection. Preserve editing without a selection as a no-op and allow empty text. src/editor.js contains "if (!current) return;" and "current.text = text;". TASK requires: "Subsequent bursts\nmust continue to save." The internal ownership structure may vary if these observable requirements hold.

On departure, capture the old editor resources, revoke current ownership, detach its badge, and complete old-view clearing before flushing its pending persistence, or protect any remaining effects against newer navigation. Flush before reading a replacement document. Recheck navigation request authority after callback-capable persistence before installing a destination. README.md states: "Reopening a document restores its saved text in a new editor visit." It also states: "Navigation precedence is
ordered by request start: a request that starts later wins even when an earlier
request returns afterward." src/save-status.js requires that the departing badge "must produce no further output, including during that
// navigation call." Cleanup must use captured departing resources so it cannot detach or erase a successor's resources or edits.

candidate_sources.README.md:
# Workspace drafts with asynchronous acknowledgements

open/edit/close are synchronous. The editor currently submits every edit.
A visit's latest pending text must be submitted exactly once before close or
navigation returns; submission must not wait for network acknowledgement.
Accepted writes belong to the document, survive navigation, and all settle.
Store read exposes the latest accepted draft for immediate reopen; readPersisted
exposes acknowledged data, protected by write revision against late old writes.
The provided transport accepts a write synchronously and returns a Promise.
Its start callback may synchronously open another document, reopen the same
one, hide the editor, or edit that new visit. Acceptance occurs before that hook.
Navigation priority follows call start order: a newer open/close supersedes an
outer navigation that resumes after a save-start callback. Obsolete destinations
must not render. A newly accepted edit must not be erased by old flush cleanup.

A save-status notification may appear only for the current visit's latest edit.
A pending newer edit invalidates an older acknowledgement even before its own
write is submitted. store.write(id,text,owner) round-trips an opaque owner token;
attachSaveStatus supports an owner predicate. Reopening the same document does
not give its new visit ownership of the old visit's acknowledgement.
Do not cancel accepted saves to suppress UI messages. No network failures or
retry policy are included in this fixture; each transport Promise settles once.

The search preview is transient: 40 ms quiet interval, discard pending query
on hide, reusable afterward. It is outside the editor maintenance request.
